text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, a sound echoed
through the quiet inn...!
Kyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah, aaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: The room is... covered in blood...!!

Checking inside the room—
a scene of blood splattered across the floor
and walls comes into view.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
No, look, it's dripping in the hallway too...!
Does that mean it came from outside into this room!?

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Guests, is everything all ri—
...What in the...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Could it be a ghost?
Or a crime scene...!?

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, Trainer-san over there is quite right.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
We'll arrange a different room for you.
Please rest easy without worry.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...Now then.
What do we have here?

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
I checked, but none of those girls
had any noticeable injuries. ...

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...For now, you head back to your room too.
Sorry for the disturbance when you came to relax.

Something definitely happened here.
I can't rest easy until the truth is known.
choice_data_list: As an adult looking after horse girls, I want to help.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Fair enough.
Guess I'll put you to work then.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Right away, before cleaning up,
we need to figure out what happened.

...Blood is dripped around the room,
but the amount itself isn't huge.

Blood traces are concentrated low down.
And they form a traceable trail—
choice_data_list: (Drips like this... where have I seen them...?)

text_block_list.text:
That's it...! Seen this before at the academy.
From how it dripped, and how quickly
it stopped, I can deduce—
choice_data_list: A nosebleed—and from a physical impact!

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
A nosebleed fits the situation.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Likely enjoyed the hot spring or sauna too much,
got dizzy, and bumped into something.
choice_data_list: Some horse girls are prone to getting nosebleeds.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
As expected of an active Trainer.
Sharp eyes.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go check on those girls
one more time.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Guests, how are you feeling?
A little tea and sweets from the inn—

...Found her.
One girl still looks pale.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait... Miss! Where are you going!
Don't run!

text_block_list.name: 青ざめたウマ娘
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant* *cough*... Ugh!
St-Stay away...!
choice_data_list: Running after a nosebleed is dangerous! Come here!
Running after a nosebleed is dangerous! Come here!

text_block_list.name: 青ざめたウマ娘
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I can't... Because, because...!
I scared everyone...!

text_block_list.name: 青ざめたウマ娘
text_block_list.text:
I ruined the fun memories... caused trouble
for the inn too... I can't go back...!

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, dear... Nothing like that... *cough*.
You did nothing... wrong at all—

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... Good grief, she's fast...!

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text: ...*ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...Other guests also get lightheaded
from the hot springs being so nice.
It is by no means rare.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
A far bigger issue than a nosebleed...
is your current state, dear guest.

text_block_list.name: 青ざめたウマ娘
text_block_list.text: ...My state?

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Turning pale at a hot spring meant for health...
defeats the whole purpose.
As landlady, I can't overlook it.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Anemia, fatigue.
And the emotional toll of worrying about friends—

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
How about it?
Why not let the hot spring steam melt it all away?
I will gladly assist with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Thanks to you, she calmed down too.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't have gone so smoothly on my own.
Your contribution was huge.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Staying calm amidst the chaos.
Having real backbone. You've got
what it takes to be a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, let me offer a small thanks.
Celebration dishes, and a private
reservation for the hot springs just opened up.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go bring it over,
just sit tight.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...Let me add a little extra perk.
I'd love to have our detective favor
our inn in the future, right?

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that happy about it?
Please, take your time.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Our inn always welcomes your patronage.
...As they say, right?
